provenance: Sequential self-authored C/D column programs executed in fresh disposable original G1 profiles, one fresh session per suite. Only independently decoded values recorded; no vendor captures or physical device.

cases.name: function_set
cases.source: EXPORT COLSET() BEGIN C1:={1,2,3}; D1:={4,5}; RETURN {C1,D1,TYPE(C1),TYPE(D1)}; END;

cases.name: start_stats2
cases.source: EXPORT STCOL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Statistics 2Var"); RETURN {C1,D1}; END;

cases.name: stats2_set
cases.source: EXPORT STSET() BEGIN C1:={9,8}; C0:={7}; RETURN {C1,C0,TYPE(C1),SIZE(C1)}; END;

cases.name: stats2_scalar
cases.source: EXPORT STSCALAR() BEGIN LOCAL r; IFERR C1:=5; THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,C1}; END;

cases.name: stats2_complex
cases.source: EXPORT STCOMPLEX() BEGIN LOCAL r; IFERR C1:={(1,2),3}; THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,C1}; END;

cases.name: types
cases.source: EXPORT COTYPES() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},r,vals:={{1,2},{#FFh,2},{"a"},{{1}},{}},k; FOR k FROM 1 TO 5 DO IFERR C1:=vals(k); r:=STRING({C1,TYPE(C1(1))}); THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); END; RETURN out; END;

cases.name: dcolumns
cases.source: EXPORT DCOLS() BEGIN D1:={4,5}; D0:={6}; RETURN STRING({D1,D0,C1,C0}); END;

cases.name: start_stats1
cases.source: EXPORT ONCOL() BEGIN STARTAPP("Statistics 1Var"); RETURN STRING({D1,C1,D0}); END;

cases.name: stats1_set
cases.source: EXPORT ONSET() BEGIN D1:={20,30,40}; D0:={6}; RETURN STRING({D1,D0,C1}); END;

cases.name: return_function
cases.source: EXPORT RETFN() BEGIN STARTAPP("Function"); RETURN STRING({C1,D1,C0,D0}); END;

cases.name: indexes
cases.source: EXPORT COINDEX() BEGIN C1:={1,2}; LOCAL r; IFERR C1(1):="x"; THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN STRING({r,C1}); END;
